notes: Labeling performed in-session by the assistant model glm-5.3 (Claude Code CLI); no external LLM API calls were made. 4 labeling batches processed all 57 CSV candidates (24 source candidates from extraction/sources.csv, 33 sink candidates from extraction/sinks.csv). Batch composition and raw per-candidate decisions are preserved in labels/labels_raw_pass1.json.
Pass 1 only (Path Traversal, CWE-22/23/36/73) per the experiment scope; pass_id and field names follow assets/labels_schema.json.

No framework reference file matches the detected framework: Augur 0.3.0 references/ has no tornado.md; source/sink shapes were derived from repository evidence (see exploration/detection.json). references/python.md and references/patterns.md were loaded.

CSV-to-schema normalization: CSV flow_kind 'arg' with argIndex>=0 maps to schema 'argument' with that arg_index; CSV 'arg' with argIndex -1 (keyword-controlled) maps to flow_kind 'unknown' with arg_index null; CSV 'field' on call-return candidates (self.get_argument, self._require_arg) normalized to 'return' because the taint node is the call result; handler 'param' rows keep their positional arg_index (self=0).

Dedup policy: no exact duplicate rows exist in either CSV; signature-level near-duplicates (e.g. builtins.open argument 0 at 17 sites, os.remove argument 0 at 4 sites) are retained as distinct entries because per-site classification differs (tp/candidate/fp). Step 4 library generation must deduplicate by (module, callable, arg_index, flow_kind).

Zero entries carry role 'sanitizer': no validation/neutralization function was among the extracted candidates. Repo-side sanitizers observed during labeling (string_util.clean_filename, UploadFileRequestHandler._is_valid_session_id, tornado library-side StaticFileHandler.validate_absolute_path) are not CSV candidates and are documented in labels/phase1_review.md instead.

entries.rationale: The 'path' parameter of ComponentRequestHandler.get is the decoded tornado route capture from `/component/(.*)` (registered at server.py:391-395). parts[0] selects a registered component; '/'.join(parts[1:]) becomes filename and is joined with os.path.join(component_root, filename) (components.py:319-320) and opened (components.py:325) with no containment check, no basename/normpath, and no allowlist. Raw '../' segments are captured directly by the (.*) regex, percent-encoded '%2e%2e%2f' additionally decode (tornado unquotes regex captures), and a filename beginning with '/' or a drive letter makes os.path.join return an absolute path. Input controllability: everything after the component name, i.e. arbitrary relative traversal depth and absolute-path forms. This is the only complete in-repo untrusted-source-to-file-open flow (pairs with sink-009).
evidence: lib/streamlit/server/server.py:391-395: route `(make_url_path_regex(base, "component/(.*)"), ComponentRequestHandler, dict(registry=ComponentRegistry.instance()))`
lib/streamlit/components/v1/components.py:310-320: `parts = path.split("/"); component_name = parts[0]; ... filename = "/".join(parts[1:]); abspath = os.path.join(component_root, filename)`
lib/streamlit/components/v1/components.py:325: `with open(abspath, "rb") as file:` -> contents returned via self.write(contents) (components.py:333)
lib/streamlit/components/v1/components.py:436-443: get_component_path only validates parts[0] against the registry; the remainder of the path is never validated
Route has no authentication and no XSRF requirement for GET; set_default_headers (components.py:351-353) can even allow cross-origin reads when CORS is disabled/development mode

Exploitation precondition: at least one component registered with a filesystem path via declare_component(path=...) — otherwise get_component_path returns None and the handler 404s (components.py:313-317)

entries.rationale: The /component/(.*) route's disk read: open(abspath, 'rb') where abspath = os.path.join(component_root, filename) and filename = '/'.join(parts[1:]) of the attacker-controlled route capture (src-012). No containment check, basename, or normalization executes before the open; '../' sequences (raw or percent-decoded by tornado's capture unquoting) traverse out of component_root, and a leading '/' or drive letter in filename makes os.path.join return an absolute path. Contents are returned to the requester (self.write, components.py:333). This is the only confirmed complete source-to-sink path-traversal flow in this database.

Precondition: a component registered with a filesystem path must exist (declare_component path=...); route is otherwise unauthenticated
